# Raw data import and setup

```{r import}
library(gtsummary)
library(bstfun)
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(styler)
library(labelled)
library(openxlsx)

# Set gtsummary theme
my_theme <- list(
  "pkgwide-fn:pvalue_fun" = function(x) gtsummary::style_pvalue(x, digits = 2),
  "pkgwide-fn:prependpvalue_fun" = function(x) gtsummary::style_pvalue(x, digits = 2, prepend_p = TRUE),
  "tbl_summary-fn:percent_fun" = function(x) paste0(round(x*100)),
  "tbl_summary-arg:statistic" = list(all_continuous() ~ "{median} [{min} \U2013 {max}]",
                                       all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)"),
  "tbl_summary-arg:missing_text" = "Missing",
  "tbl_summary-fn:addnl-fn-to-run" = "bold_labels"
)
set_gtsummary_theme(my_theme)
theme_gtsummary_compact()

# create path to secure data folder
path_data <- readr::read_lines(here::here("path_data.txt"), skip_empty_rows = TRUE)

# import raw data
df_raw <-
  readxl::read_excel(
    path = bstfun::path_data(path = path_data, "dataname.xlsx"),
    sheet = "data"
  ) %>%
  janitor::clean_names(case = "all_caps") %>% # uppercase col names
  mutate(across(where(lubridate::is.POSIXt), lubridate::as_date)) %>% # use lubridates
  mutate_if(is.logical, as.numeric)
  
# create functions 
source(here::here("_functions.R"))
```

# Raw dataset source dataframe
```{r}

df_raw_data_filenames <- tibble(
  name = c(
    "Insert file name"
  )
) |> 
  mutate(location = as.character(bstfun::path_data(path = path_data)))
```

# Check out raw data
```{r}

# Visualize missing data
naniar::gg_miss_var(df_raw)
naniar::vis_miss(df_raw) + 
  scale_x_discrete(position = "bottom") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 1, vjust = 1))
```


# Save analytic data

```{r save}

# Save raw data source information
saveRDS(
  object = df_raw_data_filenames,
  file = bstfun::path_data(path = path_data, "df_raw_data_filenames.Rds")
)

saveRDS(
  object = df_main,
  file = bstfun::path_data(path = path_data, "df_main.Rds")
)
```
